title: Foreign Currency Account - Any Bank Suggestion?
body:
Hello fellow community,
For those with a Foreign Currency Account (namely USD$), which bank is that with and how has the bank service been? Is it easy to transfer between USD to AUD and vice versa easily?
Any fees associated with the account?
I had USD account with HSBC but they appear to be closing al their Australian based accounts so need to transfer the USD out somewhere else.
Just looking for people’s experiences with their banks and/or any recommendation they may have.
Thanks in advance!
